scope: single-GPU control-path smoke experiment; not a scientific strategy ranking
measurement_boundary: CUDA-synchronized forward-only; excludes container startup, reference computation and collection
limitations: Two finite CPU-request candidates and one GPU; no NPU or training qualification
One seed, sequential strategies, shared initial history; no randomized strategy trials or holdout evaluation
Tiny kernels are overhead-sensitive; no GPU saturation or system-wide speedup claim
GPU utilization, power and temperature were not collected and remain null
Intervals are descriptive mean +/- 3 standard errors from three independent jobs, not calibrated guarantees
Failed/canceled allocation may be a conservative reservation charge, not measured consumption
Preparation cost and complete failed-job usage ledger are still incomplete
Read-only runtime PVC is operator-qualified, not an automatically attested container image
